description:
ROTARY CLUB OF BOMBAY UPTOWN
INTERACT INSTALLATION – NKES SCHOOL

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown successfully conducted the **Interact Club elections and installation ceremony at Khanolkar School**.

The student elections were well organised and conducted smoothly, providing students with an opportunity to experience democratic leadership and take responsibility for their Interact Club.

Following the elections, the newly elected Interact Board was formally installed, marking the beginning of another year of student-led service, leadership and community engagement.

The event encouraged students to develop leadership skills, teamwork and the spirit of service, in keeping with Rotary's values.

We congratulate the newly elected Interactors and wish them a successful and impactful year ahead.

Sustainable Service, Lasting Impact

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown
